Name: Custom NPC - ENA
Author: Dwessie
Description:
This mod adds ENA from Joel G's wonderful surreal youtube series (also called ENA) to your game! She's fully marriageable (marriageable? Marryable?? She can be your wife) and doesn't require like 12 mods to run. I gave her a bunch of dialogue so hopefully she uses it all for you!

Watch the mini series here: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lF3O-TXURX4&list=PLhPaJURyApsoMQDaoft5t0l0iAwUOLtlM]Youtube Link[/url]
Sprite art by me and engiSonic
Portraits by engiSonic (Seriously you're the best thank you!)


INFO:
I made her birthday Summer 26, it made sense to me.[color=#ff0000] I AM THINKING OF CHANGING IT AS I WASN'T AWARE OF LEO.[/color]
Her schedule is being worked on yet again lol
I don't know if she goes to the new events yet, I'm gonna guess no.

She lives at the bus stop. I didn't want to make you download a bunch of extra crap just for me to make her a poorly built house. I'll never regret this cause the extra mods for that seem to break a lot for me anyway.
